result.title: Neurons Are All You Need
result.summary: For decades, artificial neural networks have operated under the assumption that durable, learned capability resides exclusively in adaptive synaptic parameters, primarily due to the established neurobiology of synaptic connectivity. This design forces models to remain stateless during deployment, incurring well-known limitations such as catastrophic forgetting and expensive retraining. However, recent neurobiological research by Glanzman and colleagues, and others, shows that memories can be transferred between individual organisms in a synaptically independent manner. Inspired by this research, we sought to demonstrate memory transfer of persistent memory between AI model instances, leveraging a neurocentric version of memory. In this paper, we propose NURESA (Neural Unit with Retentive Self-Adaptive Architecture), a novel neural layer that eschews sole reliance on synaptic weight updating by introducing persistent intra-unit memory as a first-class, computational primitive. By structurally separating computation from persistent memory, NURESA enables autonomous memory accumulation and consolidation into transferable stores of memory registers. Experiments across MLP, GPT-2, and modern frontier models like Qwen2.5 demonstrate qualitatively new capability: zero-shot transfer of learned capability into a naive model instance without retraining or access to the original training data; this transfer is enabled by a sparse set of parameters in NURESA's memory register that the model selects on its own based on which neurons were most active. The memory transfer capability of NURESA also protects against domain loss when transformer models undergo learning via fine-tuning. Finally, the memory transfer process completes in approximately one minute even for transformer models with millions to billions of parameters, producing a transfer file orders of magnitude smaller than the original model.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 NURESA 神经层，把持久的单元内记忆作为独立于突触权重的计算原语，使模型在部署中自动累积并巩固记忆寄存器，并在 MLP、GPT-2、Qwen2.5 上实现无需重训的零样本能力迁移，同时缓解微调中的领域能力损失。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「计算与持久记忆结构分离、按活跃神经元自发选择稀疏记忆寄存器并可低成本转移」的设计，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的存储、复用与跨实例传递问题相关，值得核查该机制能否承载视觉证据筛选后的中间状态。
